items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Lucky, he says, oh, I'm glad, Scottie, you're just in time. And he gave me a gig.

ctx.x: called you and he's got an open gig, take it. The only thing is, he doesn't pay you right away, because those rich people, they pay by check. Like the other places, you get your money when you get through. No.

Well, I didn't mind that because I was working and I had a little money myself. He said, well, when you get an open date, then call. So I called him. Lucky, he says, oh, I'm glad, Scottie, you're just in time. And he gave me a gig. And it was for rich people, out there in Westbury.
This is after you left Chick Webb?
